evidence: Labeled 'Validation' and modifies core block index management and pruning logic in src/validation.cpp and src/node/blockstorage.cpp.
rationale: This PR resolves multiple block index integrity issues that cause assertion crashes under `CheckBlockIndex` (#31512, #36021) and undefined behavior from mutating keys in `setBlockIndexCandidates`. Delaying resolution risks node instability and state corruption during pruning and candidate selection.
